summary: A pixel-art side-scrolling beat-em-up scene shows Alex, a Black martial artist in a white gi, punching a red-bandanna fighter while a knife-wielding mohawk enemy threatens from the left and a blue-bandanna brawler closes in from the right. The fight occurs in a detailed Zenith Industries rooftop/loading yard at night beneath a moonlit city skyline.
buildPrompt: Build a playable 2D pixel-art side-scrolling beat-em-up based directly on this scene. Use Alex as the player: a Black male martial artist with a large afro, white sleeveless gi, black belt, and bare feet. Begin with three enemies visible: a pink-mohawk knife wielder on the left, a red-bandanna melee fighter being struck near center-right, and a muscular blue-bandanna melee fighter approaching from the far right. Implement close-range punches, bright impact flashes, enemy recoil, health depletion, grounded side-on movement, and scrolling through a roughly 2800-pixel-wide stage lasting about 20 seconds. Preserve the nighttime industrial environment: city skyline, moon, B7 sign, Security Level 3 door, CAUTION / KEEP OUT fence, green barrels, rust-red ZENITH INDUSTRIES container, electrical danger sign, ladder, pipes, stairs, catwalk, hazard markings, and foreground barrel. Match the dark blue, rust, gray, amber, olive, and white palette. Preserve the English arcade HUD and its visible labels: ALEX, 0124500, x3, TIME 74, PRESS START, KNIFE, BANDANNA, and STAGE 3-1. Do not replace the location, alter Alex's identity, reduce the initial three-enemy encounter, or change the fighting genre.
